layout: float32 LE; each epoch: 3 stations x [target xyz km, receiver-to-Moon xyz km, receiver zenith unit xyz]; MOON_ME at emission
method: NAIF moving-station SPK; XCN+S from Moon centre; CN+S from station at reception; pxfrm2 ITRF93(reception) to MOON_ME(emission); site-origin corrections in browser

earth_orientation.note: After recent-kernel coverage, uses low-accuracy long-term Earth prediction; stress values are engineering sensitivity inputs motivated by NAIF's 5-6 mrad orientation estimate, not confidence bounds.

limitations: One named reference 34 m antenna per complex, not every antenna
Earth orientation after the recent-kernel interval is low-accuracy prediction
Receiver horizon uses a 10 degree geometric mask, not azimuth-dependent local masks or cable wraps
No booking, weather or station hardware/configuration validity guarantee
Small site-origin/light-time and differential-aberration approximation is validated separately
